inputs.name: ReplayVideoService.constructor.repository
inputs.description: Optional repository used to load reports and resolve their directories. Defaults to new ReportRepository() when omitted.

inputs.name: ReplayVideoService.create.id
inputs.description: Report identifier passed to repository.get and repository.directory to load the report and locate its files. The method uses the supplied string without format normalization.

outputs.name: ReplayVideoService.create
outputs.description: The completed replay-video contents as a Node.js Buffer, returned from a restored cache or after generation and storage. At most two distinct in-process preparation jobs run at once; calls with a matching in-flight key reuse its job.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: The service explicitly throws this Error when the report is expired after 30 days or when two preparation jobs are already in progress and a new distinct job is requested. Errors rejected by awaited dependencies also reject create.
